concepts.gloss_en: The altar; in Torah 17 identified with the aspect of eating / a person's table (שולחנו של אדם) that atones like the altar and is the locus of intellect's rectification

reason_for_human: All five occurrences are vocalized מִזְבֵּחַ and denote the same referent — the altar — used consistently as the aspect of eating/one's table that atones and completes the intellect. The definite article (המזבח) is ordinary article/inflection, not a homograph or archetype split, so all belong to one concept.
